title: Hou Yi Shoots the Suns
synopsis: Hou Yi is a mythological archer who shot down nine of the ten suns in the sky, saving crops and people from the scorching heat.

fullText.simplified:
后羿射日

    在中国，流传着许多古老的神话故事。这些故事中，“后羿射日”是最为人所熟知的故事之一。
    这个故事发生在很久很久以前。当时天空中有十个太阳。每天，这十个太阳会轮流出来“工作”。一个太阳升起到空中，其他九个太阳则休息。然而，有一天，这十个太阳决定一起出来游玩，这让世界变得非常炎热。大地上的河流干涸了，树木也枯死了。
    人们不知道该怎么办，因为从来没有这样的情况发生过。就在这时，一位名叫后羿的英雄出现了。他是一位非常出色的弓箭手，拥有非凡的力量和技能。
    后羿拿起了他的弓箭，登上了一座高山。他看到了那十个炙热的太阳，也看到了大地上干涸的河流和枯死的树木。他知道他必须采取行动了。只见他毫不犹豫，拉弓射箭。他的箭精准而有力，一支支射中了太阳。每射下一个太阳，天空就变得稍微凉爽了一些。直到最后，天空中只剩下一个太阳，后羿才停了下来，放下了弓。因为他知道，一个太阳是最合适的。
    当后羿射下了九个太阳后，世界逐渐恢复了正常。河流再次流动，树木重新变绿。人们非常感激后羿，他们称他为大英雄，送去了许多礼物。然而，后羿并没有接受这些礼物。他说，这是他应该做的事，因为他想要让世界变得更好。
    后羿射日的故事不仅在中国广为流传，而且深受人们的喜爱。这是一个关于勇气和决心的故事，提醒我们在面对困难时要勇敢，要有信心，采取行动去改变世界。正是这种精神，让后羿成为了中国神话中的英雄，成为了我们心目中的传奇。
fullText.traditional:
后羿射日

    在中國，流傳著許多古老的神話故事。這些故事中，“后羿射日”是最為人所熟知的故事之一。
    這個故事發生在很久很久以前。當時天空中有十個太陽。每天，這十個太陽會輪流出來“工作”。一個太陽升起到空中，其他九個太陽則休息。然而，有一天，這十個太陽決定一起出來遊玩，這讓世界變得非常炎熱。大地上的河流乾涸了，樹木也枯死了。
    人們不知道該怎麼辦，因為從來沒有這樣的情況發生過。就在這時，一位名叫后羿的英雄出現了。他是一位非常出色的弓箭手，擁有非凡的力量和技能。
    后羿拿起了他的弓箭，登上了一座高山。他看到了那十個炙熱的太陽，也看到了大地上乾涸的河流和枯死的樹木。他知道他必須採取行動了。只見他毫不猶豫，拉弓射箭。他的箭精準而有力，一支支射中了太陽。每射下一個太陽，天空就變得稍微涼爽了一些。直到最後，天空中只剩下一個太陽，后羿才停了下來，放下了弓。因為他知道，一個太陽是最合適的。
    當后羿射下了九個太陽後，世界逐漸恢復了正常。河流再次流動，樹木重新變綠。人們非常感激后羿，他們稱他為大英雄，送去了許多禮物。然而，后羿並沒有接受這些禮物。他說，這是他應該做的事，因為他想要讓世界變得更好。
    后羿射日的故事不僅在中國廣為流傳，而且深受人們的喜愛。這是一個關於勇氣和決心的故事，提醒我們在面對困難時要勇敢，要有信心，採取行動去改變世界。正是這種精神，讓后羿成為了中國神話中的英雄，成為了我們心目中的傳奇。

sentences.english: Hou Yi Shoots the Suns

sentences.simplified: 在中国，流传着许多古老的神话故事。
sentences.traditional: 在中國，流傳著許多古老的神話故事。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó liú chuán zhe xǔ duō gǔ lǎo de shén huà gù shi

sentences.simplified: 这些故事中，“后羿射日”是最为人所熟知的故事之一。
sentences.traditional: 這些故事中，“后羿射日”是最為人所熟知的故事之一。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē gù shi zhōng hòu yì shè rì shì zuì wéi rén suǒ shú zhī de gù shi zhī yī
sentences.english: In China, many ancient mythological stories are passed down.
Of these stories, “Hou Yi Shoots the Suns” is one of the most well-known.

sentences.simplified: 这个故事发生在很久很久以前。当时天空中有十个太阳。
sentences.traditional: 這個故事發生在很久很久以前。當時天空中有十個太陽。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge gù shi fā shēng zài hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐ qián dāng shí tiān kōng zhōng yǒu shí ge tài yáng

sentences.simplified: 每天，这十个太阳会轮流出来“工作”。
sentences.traditional: 每天，這十個太陽會輪流出來“工作”。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān zhè shí ge tài yáng huì lún liú chu lai gōng zuò
sentences.english: This story happened a long, long time ago. There were ten suns in the sky at that time.

sentences.simplified: 一个太阳升起到空中，其他九个太阳则休息。
sentences.traditional: 一個太陽升起到空中，其他九個太陽則休息。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge tài yáng shēng qǐ dào kōng zhōng qí tā jiǔ ge tài yáng zé xiū xi
sentences.english: Every day, these ten suns would take turns to come out and “work”.

sentences.simplified: 然而，有一天，这十个太阳决定一起出来游玩，这让世界变得非常炎热。
sentences.traditional: 然而，有一天，這十個太陽決定一起出來遊玩，這讓世界變得非常炎熱。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér yǒu yì tiān zhè shí ge tài yáng jué dìng yì qǐ chū lái yóu wán zhè ràng shì jiè biàn de fēi cháng yán rè
sentences.english: One sun would rise into the sky, while the other nine suns rested.

sentences.simplified: 大地上的河流干涸了，树木也枯死了。
sentences.traditional: 大地上的河流乾涸了，樹木也枯死了。
sentences.pinyin: dà dì shang de hé liú gān hé le shù mù yě kū sǐ le
sentences.english: However, one day, these ten suns decided to come out and play together, which made the world extremely hot.
The rivers on the earth dried up, and the trees also withered.

sentences.simplified: 人们不知道该怎么办，因为从来没有这样的情况发生过。
sentences.traditional: 人們不知道該怎麼辦，因為從來沒有這樣的情況發生過。
sentences.pinyin: rén men bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn yīn wèi cóng lái méi yǒu zhè yàng de qíng kuàng fā shēng guò

sentences.simplified: 就在这时，一位名叫后羿的英雄出现了。他是一位非常出色的弓箭手，拥有非凡的力量和技能。
sentences.traditional: 就在這時，一位名叫后羿的英雄出現了。他是一位非常出色的弓箭手，擁有非凡的力量和技能。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí yí wèi míng jiào hòu yì de yīng xióng chū xiàn le tā shì yí wèi fēi cháng chū sè de gōng jiàn shǒu yōng yǒu fēi fán de lì liang hé jì néng
sentences.english: People didn’t know what to do because such a situation had never happened before.
At that moment, a hero named Hou Yi appeared. He was an exceptional archer with extraordinary strength and skills.

sentences.simplified: 后羿拿起了他的弓箭，登上了一座高山。
sentences.traditional: 后羿拿起了他的弓箭，登上了一座高山。
sentences.pinyin: hòu yì ná qǐ le tā de gōng jiàn dēng shàng le yí zuò gāo shān

sentences.simplified: 他看到了那十个炙热的太阳，也看到了大地上干涸的河流和枯死的树木。
sentences.traditional: 他看到了那十個炙熱的太陽，也看到了大地上乾涸的河流和枯死的樹木。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào le nà shí ge zhì rè de tài yáng yě kàn dào le dà dì shang gān hé de hé liú hé kū sǐ de shù mù
sentences.english: Hou Yi picked up his bow and arrow and climbed a high mountain.

sentences.simplified: 他知道他必须采取行动了。只见他毫不犹豫，拉弓射箭。
sentences.traditional: 他知道他必須採取行動了。只見他毫不猶豫，拉弓射箭。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào tā bì xū cǎi qǔ xíng dòng le zhǐ jiàn tā háo bù yóu yù lā gōng shè jiàn
sentences.english: He saw the ten blazing suns, and he also saw the dried-up rivers and withered trees on the earth.

sentences.simplified: 他的箭精准而有力，一支支射中了太阳。
sentences.traditional: 他的箭精準而有力，一支支射中了太陽。
sentences.pinyin: tā de jiàn jīng zhǔn ér yǒu lì yì zhī zhī shè zhòng le tài yáng
sentences.english: He knew he had to take action. He unhesitatingly drew his bow and shot arrows.

sentences.simplified: 每射下一个太阳，天空就变得稍微凉爽了一些。
sentences.traditional: 每射下一個太陽，天空就變得稍微涼爽了一些。
sentences.pinyin: měi shè xià yí ge tài yáng tiān kōng jiù biàn de shāo wēi liáng shuǎng le yì xiē
sentences.english: His arrows were precise and powerful, each one hitting a sun.

sentences.simplified: 直到最后，天空中只剩下一个太阳，后羿才停了下来，放下了弓。
sentences.traditional: 直到最後，天空中只剩下一個太陽，后羿才停了下來，放下了弓。
sentences.pinyin: zhí dào zuì hòu tiān kōng zhōng zhǐ shèng xià yí ge tài yáng hòu yì cái tíng le xià lai fàng xià le gōng
sentences.english: Each time a sun was shot down, the sky became slightly cooler.

sentences.simplified: 因为他知道，一个太阳是最合适的。
sentences.traditional: 因為他知道，一個太陽是最合適的。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā zhī dào yí ge tài yáng shì zuì hé shì de
sentences.english: By the end, there was only one sun left in the sky, and Hou Yi finally stopped and put down his bow.
Because he knew that having one sun was just right.

sentences.simplified: 当后羿射下了九个太阳后，世界逐渐恢复了正常。
sentences.traditional: 當后羿射下了九個太陽後，世界逐漸恢復了正常。
sentences.pinyin: dāng hòu yì shè xià le jiǔ ge tài yáng hòu shì jiè zhú jiàn huī fù le zhèng cháng

sentences.simplified: 河流再次流动，树木重新变绿。
sentences.traditional: 河流再次流動，樹木重新變綠。
sentences.pinyin: hé liú zài cì liú dòng shù mù chóng xīn biàn lǜ
sentences.english: After Hou Yi shot down nine suns, the world gradually returned to normal.

sentences.simplified: 人们非常感激后羿，他们称他为大英雄，送去了许多礼物。
sentences.traditional: 人們非常感激后羿，他們稱他為大英雄，送去了許多禮物。
sentences.pinyin: rén men fēi cháng gǎn jī hòu yì tā men chēng tā wéi dà yīng xióng sòng qù le xǔ duō lǐ wù
sentences.english: The rivers flowed again, the trees turned green once more.

sentences.simplified: 然而，后羿并没有接受这些礼物。
sentences.traditional: 然而，后羿並沒有接受這些禮物。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér hòu yì bìng méi yǒu jiē shòu zhè xiē lǐ wù
sentences.english: People were very grateful to Hou Yi, calling him a great hero and sending many gifts.

sentences.simplified: 他说，这是他应该做的事，因为他想要让世界变得更好。
sentences.traditional: 他說，這是他應該做的事，因為他想要讓世界變得更好。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō zhè shì tā yīng gāi zuò de shì yīn wèi tā xiǎng yào ràng shì jiè biàn de gèng hǎo
sentences.english: However, Hou Yi did not accept these gifts.
He said it was the right thing to do because he wanted to make the world a better place.

sentences.simplified: 后羿射日的故事不仅在中国广为流传，而且深受人们的喜爱。
sentences.traditional: 后羿射日的故事不僅在中國廣為流傳，而且深受人們的喜愛。
sentences.pinyin: hòu yì shè rì de gù shi bù jǐn zài zhōng guó guǎng wéi liú chuán ér qiě shēn shòu rén men de xǐ ài

sentences.simplified: 这是一个关于勇气和决心的故事，
sentences.traditional: 這是一個關於勇氣和決心的故事，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yí ge guān yú yǒng qì hé jué xīn de gù shi
sentences.english: The story of Hou Yi shooting the suns is not only widely told in China, but also deeply loved by people.

sentences.simplified: 提醒我们在面对困难时要勇敢，要有信心，采取行动去改变世界。
sentences.traditional: 提醒我們在面對困難時要勇敢，要有信心，採取行動去改變世界。
sentences.pinyin: tí xǐng wǒ men zài miàn duì kùn nan shí yào yǒng gǎn yào yǒu xìn xīn cǎi qǔ xíng dòng qù gǎi biàn shì jiè
sentences.english: This is a story about courage and determination, ..

sentences.simplified: 正是这种精神，让后羿成为了中国神话中的英雄，成为了我们心目中的传奇。
sentences.traditional: 正是這種精神，讓后羿成為了中國神話中的英雄，成為了我們心目中的傳奇。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng shì zhè zhǒng jīng shén ràng hòu yì chéng wéi le zhōng guó shén huà zhōng de yīng xióng chéng wéi le wǒ men xīn mù zhōng de chuán qí
sentences.english: .. reminding us to be brave, have confidence, and take action to change the world when facing difficulties.

sentence_translations: Hou Yi Shoots the Suns
In China, many ancient mythological stories are passed down.
Of these stories, “Hou Yi Shoots the Suns” is one of the most well-known.
This story happened a long, long time ago. There were ten suns in the sky at that time.
Every day, these ten suns would take turns to come out and “work”.
One sun would rise into the sky, while the other nine suns rested.
However, one day, these ten suns decided to come out and play together, which made the world extremely hot.
The rivers on the earth dried up, and the trees also withered.
People didn’t know what to do because such a situation had never happened before.
At that moment, a hero named Hou Yi appeared. He was an exceptional archer with extraordinary strength and skills.
Hou Yi picked up his bow and arrow and climbed a high mountain.
He saw the ten blazing suns, and he also saw the dried-up rivers and withered trees on the earth.
He knew he had to take action. He unhesitatingly drew his bow and shot arrows.
His arrows were precise and powerful, each one hitting a sun.
Each time a sun was shot down, the sky became slightly cooler.
By the end, there was only one sun left in the sky, and Hou Yi finally stopped and put down his bow.
Because he knew that having one sun was just right.
After Hou Yi shot down nine suns, the world gradually returned to normal.
The rivers flowed again, the trees turned green once more.
People were very grateful to Hou Yi, calling him a great hero and sending many gifts.
However, Hou Yi did not accept these gifts.
He said it was the right thing to do because he wanted to make the world a better place.
The story of Hou Yi shooting the suns is not only widely told in China, but also deeply loved by people.
This is a story about courage and determination, ..
.. reminding us to be brave, have confidence, and take action to change the world when facing difficulties.
It is precisely this spirit that made Hou Yi a hero in Chinese mythology and a legend in our hearts.
